project_info.name: Devishiv Hospital
project_info.location: B-328, Sector B Marg, near Mount, Mahanagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226006

design_system.archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Adapted for Medical Trust)
design_system.emotion: Empathetic, clean, highly trustworthy, professional, calming

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold
scale.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds with subtle 1px border (border-border). Avoid heavy shadows or glassmorphism in clinical context to ensure crisp data visibility.

components.buttons: Rounded-full or large rounded-lg. High contrast. Primary uses #0A4273, secondary uses #7ACBA5. Hover states must darken slightly. Always add transition-all duration-300.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic preferred. Use raw divs with bg-surface, rounded-3xl, and generous internal padding (p-8 to p-12).
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with rounded-xl, bg-white, subtle border, focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary.

navigation.top_bar: Highly visible red/primary background strip indicating '24x7 Emergency Services' with Toll-Free 1800 274 8000 and Reception numbers.
navigation.main_nav: Logo, Home, About Us, Experts, Services, Contact. CTA: 'Book Appointment' button.

home.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large 'Outfit' headline emphasizing 24/7 care. 'NABH Certified' badge above H1. Dual CTAs: 'Call Emergency' (Red/Distinct) & 'View Specialties'. Image overlay max bg-black/20.
home.specialties_bento: Tetris-style bento grid highlighting Ultrasound, Endoscopy, Gynaecology, Gastro Surgery, IVF.
home.testimonials: Clean, highly padded text-focused slider or grid. Emphasize compassionate care.

about_us.mission: Large text block (text-2xl to 4xl) highlighting patient safety, advanced diagnostics, and compassionate care. Use bg-surface_alt.

our_experts.layout: Grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Clean, professional doctor cards with image, name, and specialty.

scope_of_services.layout: Use Shadcn Tabs or a clean 3-column layout. Categories: Clinical OPD+IPD, Diagnostic Services, Allied/Support Services.

contact_and_location.layout: Split section (Text/Form on left, Details/Map on right).

forms.contact: Fields: Name, Phone, Email, Message. Submit triggers sonner toast.
forms.appointment: Fields: Select Doctor (dropdown), Date (DayPicker calendar), Time Slot, Patient Name, Phone. Submit triggers sonner toast.

footer.layout: Dark background (bg-primary) with white text. Address, contact numbers, hours, quick links, and large hospital name branding.

hero_building.description: Modern hospital building architecture exterior (use for hero background or about us)

compassionate_care.description: Compassionate doctor with patient (use for mission or testimonials section)

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
technical_requirements.accessibility: Ensure high contrast. Form inputs must have labels. Images must have alt text.
